U.S. Ambassador to Türkiye Tom Barrack on Iran:
It's very difficult for the average Iranian to survive. Once they get out of a chokehold of that, over time they can change their own regime. 
We've changed it three times, right? We installed the Shah. We installed Khomeini in 1979. We took out the Shah.

U.S. Ambassador to Türkiye Tom Barrack on Israel:
Tactically, Israel technologically is brilliant, and they're smart and they're capable. 
I don't think they're evil; I think they're doing it out of what they feel their self-survival is. 
But strategically, it's an implosion. It's just an implosion.

U.S. Ambassador to Türkiye Tom Barrack on Israel:
I've had this discussion with the Israelis, because as I told you, even though they don't think it, I'm their best friend in the Arab world. 
Because I'm constantly trying to convince the Arab leaders that the only way out of this ultimately is to align. And I think for Israel, they get it too.

Q: Your ambassador to Türkiye said that "absolutely" there could be a strike on Iran this weekend.
Trump: He is a powerful man, I guess.
I don't know anything about it.

U.S. Ambassador to Türkiye Tom Barrack on Syria:
I think Israel and Syria will come to terms, because President al-Sharaa has been very clear of saying, "I have no predatory interest to you, and I want to calm these waters."
And al-Sharaa doesn't have a Hezbollah, he hasn't fired a shot, they've never attacked Israel. He's telling Israel we don't want to attack. 
Israel is just saying, "Uh, I'm not so sure of you yet. You were a fundamentalist, al-Nusra warrior. You have foreign fighters that are in the divisions along my border. I need some room along my border. After October 7th, I'm just not going to allow anybody to cross my border."
So we're in a trust-building—we had five great border and boundary discussions with them, starting in Paris in May of 2024. We almost got there. I think we'll get there again.

U.S. Ambassador to Türkiye Tom Barrack on Syria:
The Druze can arm themselves with the money that they're making from the Captagon trade. This Captagon is something, and it's like manufacturing meth.
So Syria has been very cautious. It knows that if it bites on one of these incursions, the fire is going to explode. 
So it's been very patient in allowing Israel to protect its "buffer zone" by coming across and having the Druze conduct themselves inappropriately. 
To the extent that this Sheikh is intimating to people that he has the U.S. backing, it's absolutely wrong.

U.S. Ambassador to Türkiye Tom Barrack on Saudi Arabia:
MBS sat me down and for three hours, in Arabic, gave me the history of Ibn Saud, of Saudi Arabia, but in such detail that I had never heard. 
And I thought I was well-versed because I was thrown there as a young lawyer, so I knew the Kingdom.

U.S. Ambassador to Türkiye Tom Barrack on Saudi Arabia:
The bargain with the Wahhabis on the inside never envisioned the modernization of the Kingdom. So MBS is fighting two battles at one time.
As he's spending money for Vision 2030, the Wahhabi tribes and the Bedouin tribes are saying: "I'm not so sure about this kid. I'm not so sure that we want this, I'm not so sure we want alcohol, I don't think we want Westerners to take over," right? 
All of the things that we know that they say.
